verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms the core Gitleaks CLI is a single static binary that runs fully offline and keyless with no telemetry prompt, account, or server component, meaning there is no tracking to opt out of. However, this is inferred from a runtime probe rather than an explicit vendor privacy/telemetry policy, and the separate gitleaks-action CI integration does make outbound GitHub API calls (PR comments) that aren't addressed from a telemetry standpoint. Missing for 10: an explicit written telemetry/privacy policy statement, and clarification on any data handling in gitleaks-action's GitHub API calls.
